items: The Latest Kid's Tablet - This tablet, designed specifically for children aged 2 to 12, comes preloaded with kid-friendly apps and features an advanced parental control system. All apps are downloadable, with the Kids' App Store offering a variety of games and learning platforms. Content filtering ensures children only access age-appropriate material, allowing them to play and learn freely without constant supervision.

Parental Controls - This 10-inch Kids tablet features a built-in parental control system. With comprehensive parental controls, you can easily manage your child's screen time, set learning goals, and adjust these settings according to their age.Manage app usage and filter content to ensure a safe, age-appropriate experience.

Eye Protection and Storage - This tablet is designed to protect children's eyesight, featuring a 1280*800 high-definition IPS screen resolution and wide viewing angles for a more realistic viewing experience. It reduces eye fatigue and protects eyesight. 24GB RAM (4GB + 20GB) and 64GB internal storage, expandable up to 1TB via Micro SD card (sold separately).

Octa-core Processor and Android 16 Tablet - This aiprotablet tablet is powered by a powerful Unisoc T606 octa-core processor with a CPU frequency of up to 1.6 GHz. This makes task switching smoother and the user experience more seamless. This Android tablet is GMS certified, and support the Google Play app store for easy access.

Featured Tablet - This aiprotablet tablet runs the latest Android 16 operating system and supports dual-band Wi-Fi for improved network speed and stability. It also features dual speakers, Bluetooth, and an FM radio for convenient online learning and video calls. More entertainment and efficiency features.

6000mAh Battery and PD Fast Charging - Equipped with a built-in 6000mAh lithium battery, this Android tablet supports 18W PD fast charging, compatible with most chargers on the market. It also features face recognition, automatic wake-up, low battery reminders, and charging reminders, enhancing convenience and ease of use.
